limits: Five original JSON id fields are blank; filename/name PPSA and exact version are preserved and disclosed without silent repair.
Game identity in the SHN index is used only as name evidence, never to apply a different SHN game version to a JSON file.
All six files are native PPSA definitions, distinct from PS4 CUSA backward-compatibility patches.
The repository credits the original cheat creators. etaHEN provides format/toolbox support; it does not claim authorship of every cheat.
No firmware compatibility, successful hardware execution or stable gameplay result is inferred from static checks.
No payload, cheat or commercial game executable was run; no shared host source, catalogue, helper or inventory was changed.
